entities.summary: Heo Seung, better known by his stage name Justhis (Korean: 저스디스), is a South Korean rapper. He released his first album, 2 Many Homes 4 1 Kid, on June 14, 2016. He is a member of the Korean hip hop crew IMJMWDP. After departing from GROOVL1N in November 2025, he continued his activities independently through All Caps Entertainment, a label he founded himself. The company was established on June 9, 2022, with its business registration formally reported on April 23, 2024.
